title: Independent adversarial review of the F6-R2/F6-R3 vanished-record fixes in Story 1.2
summary: Perform a fresh read-only adversarial review of the Story 1.2 mutation-lock protocol after the F6-R2 and F6-R3 corrections, which extend the F6-R1 design so that a marker or owner record observed to exist and then found gone is re-observed inside the bounded budget instead of producing OPERATION_LOCK_OWNER_UNVERIFIABLE with remove-by-hand guidance. Independently attack the two fixed sites and their interaction with the F6-R1 publication-window wait, stale reclaim, N-way contention, owner and reclaimer interleavings, process death, identity changes, and all prior F6 scenarios. Evaluate the implementer's five documented residual risks, including re-observation spending an acquisition attempt rather than a wait slice and the single-stat discriminator after a failed read. Verify the new deterministic regressions are genuine and anti-vacuous, hunt for further members of the same vanished-record defect class anywhere in the lock protocol, then rerun every Story 1.2 gate including git diff --check. This review gates the story freeze decision. Report findings only; do not modify repository files.
